chapterInfo.content:
48
Ɔman akomapirimfoɔ ateatea
1 # Yes 51.1 Montie yei, O Yakob fie,
mo a wɔde Israel din ato mo
na mofiri Yuda asene mu no,
mo a mode AWURADE din ka ntam
na mobɔ Israel Nyankopɔn din,
na ɛnyɛ nokorɛ anaa tenenee mu no.
2Na wɔde kuro kronkron no frɛ wɔn ho,
na wɔtwere Israel Nyankopɔn
a asafo AWURADE ne ne din no.
3Akane nnoɔma no, mefiri mekaeɛ ɛnyɛ nnɛ,
na ɛfirii m’anomu, na mama wɔate;
mpofirim na meyɛeɛ, na ɛbae.
4 # Yer 5.3 Ɛfiri sɛ menim sɛ woyɛ asoɔden,
na wo kɔn yɛ daban,
na wo moma yɛ yaawa;
5enti na meka mekyerɛɛ woɔ akyɛ;
ɛnnya mmaeɛ no, memaa wotee,
na woanka sɛ: M’adwinhoni na ɔyɛeɛ,
me honi a wɔasene ne me guo honi na wɔhyɛeɛ.
6Woate; hwɛ yei nyinaa;
na wo nso worenka nkyerɛ?
Merema woate nsɛm foforɔ afiri sɛsɛɛ,
ne deɛ wɔakora a wonhunuiɛ no;
7afei na wɔabɔ, na ɛmfiri tete,
na wontee da gye nnɛ,
na woanka sɛ: Hwɛ, menim dada.
8Wontee pɛn, nso wonhunui,
ɛfiri tete na w’aso mmueeɛ;
na menim sɛ nkontompo ara na wotwa,
na wɔfrɛ wo mmaratofoɔ firi yafunu mu.
9Me din nti na metwentwɛn m’abufuo aseɛ,
na m’ayeyie nti medwoo m’ani memaa wo,
na manku wo.
10 # Dwom 66.10 Hwɛ, manane wo, nso ɛnte sɛ dwetɛ;
masɔ wo mahwɛ wɔ amaneɛ fononoo mu.
11 # Yes 42.8 Me nti, me nti na meyɛ;
ɛfiri sɛ wɔngu me din ho fi sɛn?
Meremfa m’animuonyam memma obi.
Adom foforɔ ne nkwagyeɛ foforɔ
12 # Yes 41.4 Tie me, O Yakob,
ne Israel a mafrɛ woɔ,
mene ɔno ara, mene odikanfoɔ,
na me ara nso ne okyidifoɔ.
13Nso me nsa na ɛhyɛɛ asase aseɛ,
na me nsa nifa de ɔsoro trɛɛ hɔ;
sɛ mefrɛ wɔn a,
wɔn nyinaa bɛgyinagyina hɔ.
14 # Yes 41.2 Mo nyinaa mommoaboa mo ano ntie:
Wɔn mu hwan na ɔkaa yeinom?
Deɛ AWURADE dɔ no no
bɛyɛ n’anisɔdeɛ wɔ Babel ho,
na ne basa atia Kaldeafoɔ.
15Me, me na maka, nso mafrɛ no.
Mama no aba, na ne kwan yɛ no siadeɛ kwan.
16 # Yes 45.19 Montwe mpini me, montie yei.
Ɛnyɛ ahuntaeɛ mu na mefiri mfitiaseɛ mekasaeɛ;
ɛfiri berɛ a ɛbaeɛ no, na mewɔ hɔ,
na afei AWURADE Nyankopɔn asoma me ne ne honhom.
17Sɛ AWURADE,
wo Gyefoɔ, Israel Kronkronni no seɛ nie:
Mene AWURADE, wo Nyankopɔn,
mene deɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛ wo deɛ ɛyɛ ma woɔ,
na ɔgya wo kɔ ɔkwan a fa soɔ no soɔ.
18 # Deut 5.29 Sɛ wowɛn w’aso ma me mmara nsɛm ɛ,
anka w’asomdwoeɛ bɛyɛ sɛ asubɔnten,
na wo tenenee ayɛ sɛ ɛpo asorɔkyeɛ,
19na w’asefoɔ adɔre sɛ anwea,
na w’asefoɔ ayɛ sɛ n’aboseaa.
Wɔrentwa wɔn din ntwene,
na wɔrensɛe no mfiri m’anim.
20 # Yes 52.11; Yer 51.6; 2 Ko 6.17; Adi 18.4 Momfiri Babel, momfa ahurisidie nne nnwane mfiri Kaldeafoɔ mu.
Monka, momma wɔnte yei,
momma no mfiri nkɔduru asase ano.
Monka sɛ: AWURADE agye n’akoa Yakob.
21 # Eks 17.6 Ɔde wɔn nam anwea pradada soɔ no, sukɔm anne wɔn;
ɔtuee nsuo firii ɔbotan mu maa wɔn,
ɔpaee ɔbotan mu maa nsuo senee.
22 # Yes 57.21; 66.24 Asomdwoeɛ nni hɔ mma abɔnefoɔ, AWURADE na ɔseɛ.

Montie yei, O Yakob fie,
mo a wɔde Israel din ato mo
na mofiri Yuda asene mu no,
mo a mode AWURADE din ka ntam
na mobɔ Israel Nyankopɔn din,
na ɛnyɛ nokorɛ anaa tenenee mu no.
Na wɔde kuro kronkron no frɛ wɔn ho,
na wɔtwere Israel Nyankopɔn
a asafo AWURADE ne ne din no.

Akane nnoɔma no, mefiri mekaeɛ ɛnyɛ nnɛ,
na ɛfirii m’anomu, na mama wɔate;
mpofirim na meyɛeɛ, na ɛbae.
Ɛfiri sɛ menim sɛ woyɛ asoɔden,
na wo kɔn yɛ daban,
na wo moma yɛ yaawa;
enti na meka mekyerɛɛ woɔ akyɛ;
ɛnnya mmaeɛ no, memaa wotee,
na woanka sɛ: M’adwinhoni na ɔyɛeɛ,
me honi a wɔasene ne me guo honi na wɔhyɛeɛ.

Woate; hwɛ yei nyinaa;
na wo nso worenka nkyerɛ?
Merema woate nsɛm foforɔ afiri sɛsɛɛ,
ne deɛ wɔakora a wonhunuiɛ no;
afei na wɔabɔ, na ɛmfiri tete,
na wontee da gye nnɛ,
na woanka sɛ: Hwɛ, menim dada.
Wontee pɛn, nso wonhunui,
ɛfiri tete na w’aso mmueeɛ;
na menim sɛ nkontompo ara na wotwa,
na wɔfrɛ wo mmaratofoɔ firi yafunu mu.

Me din nti na metwentwɛn m’abufuo aseɛ,
na m’ayeyie nti medwoo m’ani memaa wo,
na manku wo.
Hwɛ, manane wo, nso ɛnte sɛ dwetɛ;
masɔ wo mahwɛ wɔ amaneɛ fononoo mu.
Me nti, me nti na meyɛ;
ɛfiri sɛ wɔngu me din ho fi sɛn?
Meremfa m’animuonyam memma obi.


Tie me, O Yakob,
ne Israel a mafrɛ woɔ,
mene ɔno ara, mene odikanfoɔ,
na me ara nso ne okyidifoɔ.
Nso me nsa na ɛhyɛɛ asase aseɛ,
na me nsa nifa de ɔsoro trɛɛ hɔ;
sɛ mefrɛ wɔn a,
wɔn nyinaa bɛgyinagyina hɔ.

Mo nyinaa mommoaboa mo ano ntie:
Wɔn mu hwan na ɔkaa yeinom?
Deɛ AWURADE dɔ no no
bɛyɛ n’anisɔdeɛ wɔ Babel ho,
na ne basa atia Kaldeafoɔ.
Me, me na maka, nso mafrɛ no.
Mama no aba, na ne kwan yɛ no siadeɛ kwan.
Montwe mpini me, montie yei.
Ɛnyɛ ahuntaeɛ mu na mefiri mfitiaseɛ mekasaeɛ;
ɛfiri berɛ a ɛbaeɛ no, na mewɔ hɔ,
na afei AWURADE Nyankopɔn asoma me ne ne honhom.

Sɛ AWURADE,
wo Gyefoɔ, Israel Kronkronni no seɛ nie:
Mene AWURADE, wo Nyankopɔn,
mene deɛ ɔkyerɛkyerɛ wo deɛ ɛyɛ ma woɔ,
na ɔgya wo kɔ ɔkwan a fa soɔ no soɔ.
Sɛ wowɛn w’aso ma me mmara nsɛm ɛ,
anka w’asomdwoeɛ bɛyɛ sɛ asubɔnten,
na wo tenenee ayɛ sɛ ɛpo asorɔkyeɛ,
na w’asefoɔ adɔre sɛ anwea,
na w’asefoɔ ayɛ sɛ n’aboseaa.
Wɔrentwa wɔn din ntwene,
na wɔrensɛe no mfiri m’anim.

Momfiri Babel, momfa ahurisidie nne nnwane mfiri Kaldeafoɔ mu.
Monka, momma wɔnte yei,
momma no mfiri nkɔduru asase ano.
Monka sɛ: AWURADE agye n’akoa Yakob.
Ɔde wɔn nam anwea pradada soɔ no, sukɔm anne wɔn;
ɔtuee nsuo firii ɔbotan mu maa wɔn,
ɔpaee ɔbotan mu maa nsuo senee.
Asomdwoeɛ nni hɔ mma abɔnefoɔ, AWURADE na ɔseɛ.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
